name: 𝕏 Lookalikes
tagline: Shows you public X accounts that look like they are pretending to be you: a copied name, a lookalike handle, a copied bio, or a claim to be you.
description: Shows you public X accounts that look like they are pretending to be you: a copied name, a lookalike handle, a copied bio, or a claim to be you. It does not report them to X, fill out the impersonation form, post, follow, or message anyone. Installing it adds a new bot. It does not edit or replace bots you already have. If you want X to review one, you open that form and submit it yourself.
author: LaceyPresley
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
